name: DiGiket
summary: Veteran legal Japanese indie digital storefront specializing cleanly in uncensored/mosaic doujinshi, ASMR voices, and indie eroge.
ranking_rationale: Friendly indie approval rules welcoming small niche circles missed by big stores (trade-off: 1990s/2000s Japanese web UI takes getting used to).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Friendly indie approval rules welcoming small niche circles missed by big stores
Frequently runs generous point-back bundle sales
Instant DRM-clean ZIP/PDF downloads after checkout
cons: 1990s/2000s Japanese web UI takes getting used to
Non-Japanese cards sometimes require BitCash/point workarounds
